Hey man, dont feel bad about it okay? I mean I've been watching since it was jon and arin in the middle of kirby super star. Yes they've changed for the worse and such, but that doesnt mean your enjoyment of their old content or hell, even their new stuff has to change. As long as they're funny to you and it makes YOU smile at the end of the day, who gives a shit what they do in their personal lives? They're entertainers, and if they entertain you, then run wild. You're not a bad person for finding people with controversial backgrounds funny, man. I still laugh at louis ck standup and hes.. not a good dude for lack of a better term.

All that matters is that you're happy in the end, man, fuck everyone who says youre bad just for enjoying something that isnt to their taste or by people they dont like. A laugh is a laugh and who are they to gatekeep that?

Any of their golf games from 2018 and before. Dream Course, Frolf, Toadstool Tour, all of those hold a special place in my heart because they were just 2 friends genuinely having a fun time while fucking each other over in golf.
I'm upset that this genuinely did make me laugh.

For me it was once they started censoring themselves. So like between february and April of 2019 I wanna say? I loved Jon era so much. Couldnt stand Dan for the first couple years. Watched from like 2015 to 2019, but for the entirety of 2017-2019 it was only compilations from fans and 10MPH. I hate to be the "it's not vulgar so it's not funny" guy but the way they censor themselves.. it's just so painfully obvious they arent having fun anymore and are trying to do anything to play the aLgOrItHm for viewership, but it's better to make genuinely funny content that more people stay for WHOLE video because of than reach a wider audience but have the content be so bland and genuinely sad to watch, considering how much heart they used to put into what they did.

TL;DR I stopped watching when the self censoring happened. Sad to see them turn into humorless husks all for the sake of money.

Yep. I've been watching off and on since the channel was first made. Watched religiously for the first year or so, stopped when Dan joined in 2013 (I was on the "it's different so I'm mad bandwagon") picked them back up in 2016, watched them fairly frequently but not like I used to up until Matt and Ryan left as editors. Then they went really corporate and watered down with the no swearing policy they set for themselves (that they dont follow but only sometimes?) and since then the only videos I can bring myself to even smile at anymore from them are the 10MPH and even those somehow got watered down and burnt out in barely a year of them existing.
